entries.hypothesis: With 256 equal scores, signed 8-bit probabilities round every element to zero.
entries.outcome: Reproduced the 2026-11-11 pilot exactly. 256 tokens: P8 signed code 0 (zero row), P9 signed 1, P10 signed 2, P8 unsigned (qmax 255) 1. At 1024 tokens all are zero.
entries.limitations: Synthetic; says nothing about real data.

entries.hypothesis: The INT8 loss comes from attention-probability precision (flat rows), not from weights or linear activations.
entries.outcome: 10 variants on the canonical validation split (47,580 windows / 195 files; paired file bootstrap). Flat-row hypothesis REJECTED by the frozen gate: 0 all-zero attention rows in every variant (criteria 1 and 2 fail). Mechanism found instead: probability-mass truncation (row mass 0.986 INT10 / 0.829 P8-signed / 0.948 P8-unsigned; nonzero entries per row 185 / 79 / 137; context error 0.074 / 0.225 / 0.115). Macro-F1 change vs INT10 (pp): W8 -0.01 [-0.12,0.14]; A8 -0.62; P8 signed -1.27; P8 unsigned +0.49 [-0.18,1.21]; uniform INT8 -1.82; W8A8+P10 -0.65; W8A8+P8u -0.23 [-1.36,0.38]. P9-signed and P8-unsigned are the same quantizer (qmax 255) and give identical outputs (consistency check). Accuracy gate passed by: W8, P8u(=P9s), W8A8+P8u(=P9s).
entries.limitations: Float-input path (input quantized at the variant's own input scale); a W8A8 hardware variant would also need an 8-bit on-chip preprocessing constant. Validation only; per-class CIs are wide (normal class has 5 validation files).
entries.next_action: Precision finalists for A05: W8A8+P8u (largest expected saving) and/or P8u alone; requires a versioned export, HLS types, own goldens and an integrated build to test the >= 15 % post-route gate.

entries.hypothesis: Some HLS widths exceed proven legal ranges; narrowing them is exact and cheaper.
entries.status: implemented (proof + exhaustive check for the softmax divider)
entries.outcome: Survey of the canonical HLS report: HLS already narrows most requant multipliers (23-24 bit x 32 bit). Candidate not inferred by HLS: attention context requant (df_head_*: mul_33s_33ns_64). Proof sketch: row sum of probability codes <= 511 + 256/2 = 639, |v| <= 511 -> |context accumulator| <= 326,529 < 2^19 (20-bit signed). Second candidate found and taken to A04: the softmax divider (quotient <= 511).
entries.next_action: single-operator HLS + Vivado OOC probe (A04) of the context requant: original vs proven-width

entries.hypothesis: Silent class corruption is concentrated in a few stage groups.
entries.outcome: 3,072 transient single-bit flips (8 groups x 3 bit bands x 128) on 256 validation windows (64/class); injection disabled = canonical logits on all 256. Silent class corruptions 75: G8 logits high bits 42, G1 input codes high bits 28, G2 projection accumulator mid bits 4, G3 QKV high 1. Attention scores/probabilities/context: 0 class changes in 3 x 384 injections. Proven-range check C2 flags 100 % of high-band flips in the 32-bit accumulators (G2/G6/G7), incl. all 14 class changes in G2-high; row-sum check C3 flags 65/384 probability flips. Gate (top-2 groups >= 60 % of silent corruptions): PASSED (93 %).
entries.limitations: Python INT10 reference with hardware widths; one window per event (no vote state); persistent weight-read and vote-state campaigns not yet run; logical emulation only.
entries.next_action: Add W (persistent weight) and V (vote state) campaigns; design minimal protection: parity on the input buffer, duplicated classifier tail/argmax, proven-range comparators; then B02 overlay decision

entries.hypothesis: Finite-horizon integer evidence lowers decision delay versus k-vote at a matched false-switch budget.
entries.outcome: Validation (selection; budget = vote_5 13.87 false switches/10k): vote_5 acc 99.58 %, p95 2; hyst_3 acc 99.68 %, 4.41 fsw/10k, p95 2; evid_64 acc 99.84 %, 11.77 fsw/10k, p95 1. Frozen gate formally passed (p95 -50 %, F1 not lower, unresolved not increased) but the gain is ONE window and hysteresis has 2.7x fewer false switches: no clear dominance. Board test logits (reported once): evid_64 acc 99.71 % / F1 99.47 % / 12.3 fsw/10k vs vote_5 99.08 % / 98.52 % / 18.3; hyst_3 99.22 % / 3.35 fsw/10k / p95 4. 0 dB stream: all policies 16-18 unresolved transitions. Synthetic 2-window events detected: evid 89 %, vote_5 17 %, hyst_3 10 %.
entries.limitations: Transitions are recording joins (synthetic), integer delay granularity, validation has few transitions; previously explored test.
entries.next_action: Hold FPGA implementation (conditional). If pursued: evid_64 needs 4 x ~9-bit counters + margin (top1-top2) in logic.
